infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kitchen Memory uses your camera to record a short kitchen tour so we can remember what food you have.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: We record audio along with your kitchen tour video (you can talk through what you see).
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kitchen Memory can use a kitchen tour video from your photo library instead of recording a new one.
